title: Parts Charge of a Readjustment — Alignment Services & Plans Price Sheet
content:
**Price sheet — parts on an Alignment Services & Plans readjustment.**

The parts amount of a readjustment is the parts the store listed on it at their list price, and the parts charge is the parts amount, rounded to the nearest cent. The listed parts are the replacement parts the store entered as the parts charge of the open readjustment, which cites the alignment it corrects and carries its own date and odometer.

| Parts listed on the readjustment (hypothetical) | Parts amount | Parts charge |
|---|---|---|
| 42.50 | 42.50 | 42.50 |
| 0.00 (no parts installed) | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 18.374 | 18.374 | 18.37, rounded to the nearest cent |
